method: Extracted and executed the toy retrieval fence and tested the reranker through a mocked urllib transport; asserted the reranker installs its redirect-rejecting handler, the real urllib opener has exactly one redirect handler, and the handler refuses a cross-origin redirect carrying a dummy API-key header; ran source-scope assertions.
limitations: The five-document fixture and character-hash embedding are didactic only; they do not measure semantic retrieval or ANN quality.

The mocked transport and dummy redirect request validate local urllib handler wiring only; they do not validate a live provider, endpoint schema, current model behavior, billing, latency, or historical ranking results.
